$description: Vantage design tokens — W3C Design Tokens format, generated from src/ui/theme.js (Vantage redesign handoff). Import into Figma with a variables-import plugin (e.g. 'Tokens Studio' or 'Variables Import/Export') to get an editable variable collection. theme.js stays the source of truth: regenerate this file when the theme changes.

surface.$description: Note that 'alt' is DARKER than the card surface, not lighter: dropdowns and floating chips read as cut into the page rather than lifted off it, so ordering these by brightness would misrepresent the ladder.

text.$description: The ramp tops out at #e6e8eb. There is no pure white in this system — #ffffff against these near-blacks glares.

accent.$description: ONE accent, ONE primary action per screen. The previous UI put acid yellow on GO, LIVE, +Add, the tabs and today's date at once, so nothing read as primary. Green is reserved for the main action and for positive/live states; everything else is a neutral surface or an outline.

green-hover.$description: Hover step of the primary action

green-press.$description: Pressed state of the primary action

data.$description: Direction colours. On-air is green here, not red — it is a positive state, and the redesign gives #4cc38a to positive numbers and 'on air' by the same name.

warning.$description: Market-closed dot, alert dot — the one cautionary voice

on-fill.$description: Label colour on any green fill — 6.3:1 on #46a758, where #e6e8eb would be 3.1:1

board.$description: Chess squares, named because the game reads them directly.

radius.$description: By role rather than by size.

spacing.$description: The redesign's spacing set. This is NOT a renaming of the 4px ladder still exported as SP in theme.js — that ladder stays put so existing call sites do not shift under themselves; rebuilt screens take these values.

touch-min.$description: Minimum touch target anywhere in the product

type.$description: Two faces, and the split is load-bearing: Schibsted Grotesk carries UI and prose, JetBrains Mono carries numbers, tickers, timestamps and code. Mono NEVER sets body copy, buttons or questions. Unlike the previous system this one bolds — card titles are 700. Uppercase mono labels take POSITIVE tracking, the opposite of headings.

shadow.$description: This system uses real shadows — three of them, each with one job.

accent-hover.$description: The green lift under a hovered primary button

floating-chip.$description: The chip overlapping the hero card's corner

motion.$description: Named keyframes defined in src/ui/global.css. All are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion except the fade-ups, which become instant opacity.

marquee.$description: Ticker tape, translateX(0 → -50%), linear infinite, content duplicated

pulse.$description: Live dots and carets — opacity 1 → 0.35 → 1; carets use steps(1)

state.$description: Hover and state transitions; buttons lift 2px, cards 4–6px
